Commentary.Commentary: It was a collective performance from the Bangladeshi bowlers. Barring Abu Hider, everyone was relatively economical and most managed to pick some wickets as well. The gamble from Shakib to use his spinners, including himself, in the death overs paid off as the Afghan batsmen lost their wickets trying to finish off big. Well, half the battle is won, but the biggest one remains. Bangaldesh's batting has let them down largely and now, they will have to post their biggest total of the series tonight. Should be interesting to see how it unfolds. Join us in a while for the chase.

A good bowling performance from Bangladesh to restrict Afghanistan to 145. The 'hosts' got off to a solid start as the opening pair put on a fifty-run stand, but since then the Tigers kept things tight by picking up wickets at regular intervals. There were two good partnerships, both involving Shenwari. He shared it with Stanikzai and Najibullah. But aside from that, there wasn't anything of note. Nabi failed to get going and that probably was why they didn't even get to the 150-mark.

A good finish to the innings. Another faster one from Islam and Shenwari could only get it to the cover region. Just one run taken, a very poor running between the wickets. Rashid Khan was eyeing the second one but Shenwari didn't respond, in fact, he is seen clutching his hamstring. Tremendous final over by Islam, AFGHANISTAN MANAGE 145/6 ON THE BOARD!
Right in the blockhole! Good bowling from the bowler. He is not allowing any easy runs to the Afghanistan batsmen.
Gives the charge and powers the ball to the mid-wicket region. One run added to the total. These singles won't hurt Bangladesh. They have dragged back this game a touch.
This is a bit too unorthodox from Shenwari. Goes for the reverse sweep but couldn't get it past the backward point fielder. Intelligent bowling from Islam.
Rashid Khan is out next.

OUT! He gets his man this time. Similar delivery from the bowler and similar kind of shot from Shafiqullah as well. The difference is the top edge. He tries the big shot off the flighted delivery on off. Mistimes. The ball hangs in the air and Mehidy Hasan at point, steadies himself and takes the catch. Afghanistan's batsmen are falling like nine pins and they haven't scored as many as they would have liked. Good comeback from the Bangladesh bowlers.

Islam flights this one beautifully, entices the batsman for a big hit who falls prey. He goes for a hoick across the line but misses the delivery altogether as the ball misses the stumps and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
Nazmul Islam will bowl the final over of the innings.
The batsman gives this a full swing of the bat, down on one knee for a sweep. The batsmen have run through for a single as the ball goes to long on.
Dances down the track and punches it long on for another single.
Shenwari nudges the faster delivery to mid-wicket. They take two before the fielder could cut it out.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Goes across the line on the very first ball. Gets it off the outside half of the bat and the ball lobs in the air. The fielder at long off runs to his left and keeps the ball inside the boundary to save two for his team.
Shafiqullah Shafiq is the new man in.

OUT! Captain gets a much-needed wicket for Bangladesh. He bowls a flighted delivery on the off stump, Najibullah goes for the big one over the long on fielder but doesn't get the timing right. Mahmudullah was stationed for this precise shot as he takes an easy catch. A breakthrough for the visitors.
Shakib Al Hasan into the attack again.
Full toss on the stumps, worked just wide of mid on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, a back foot punch from the batsman to long off for one.

SIX! BOOM! Shenwari is a man in sublime form. No stopping him, is there? Sees the ball landing short so he stays back and swings hard across the line. Sends it flat over the mid-wicket boundary and earns a biggie to his name.
Slower length ball outside the line of off stump, Najibullah attempts to push it on the off side but gets an inside edge past the leg stump. Single taken.
Short of a length around off, Hider takes the pace off it and deceives Shenwari. He's into the pull shot too early and gets it off the shoulder on the off side. Leg bye taken.
FOUR! Shot. Goes down the ground and gets the desired result. Full outside off, Shenwari drills this through mid off and beats the man out in the deep. Super start to the over.
Abu Hider back into the attack.
Punches the shortish delivery off the back foot and takes a single.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. One run added to the total. Leg byes given by the umpire.

FOUR! WOW! Short hand jab! This had a shadow of Yuvraj Singh in it. He gets a full delivery just outside off and he packs a punch with a straight bat and plays it over the mid off fielder for a one bounce four. 10 off 2 for Zadran.

SIX! It has gone miles in the air and into the stands. Zadran connects this one beautifully and swings his bat for a maximum. Coming to the delivery, it was bowled short and gave some room to the left-hander. He swings his bat hard and pulls it over the square leg boundary. Fast hands from the youngster and some much-needed acceleration for the team in blue.
Gets a bottom edge on the short of a length delivery. The ball goes behind the wicket and the keeper pouches it with ease. Pressure on the batsman.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. The fielding side is asking the question. The umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
Drives one to the cover region and takes a single.
Gets forward and blocks it with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Zadran isn't getting his timing right. Goes down the track to power it through mid-wicket but hits it straight to the fielder there.
Defends the flatter delivery back to the bowler from the back foot.
Played to mid-wicket for nothing.
Rocks on the back foot and punches it wide of long on. One run taken.
Shakib Al Hasan is back.
The batsman plays the pull shot with a flat bat to square leg. They pick up a single.
Mistimed pull from Zadran off the short delivery. The ball goes to the mid-wicket region and he takes another single.
Shenwari opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single
The batsman plays the square cut from the crease and picks up a single.
On a good length, coming into Zadran, he fails to put bat on ball as it hits him on his pad. The ball rolls to the on side and they take two. The umpire signals leg byes.
Najibullah Zadran strides out to bat next.

OUT! Big fish for Jayed! Nabi couldn't repeat the feat of his last match. He would consider this as a soft dismissal. Gets a full ball on the off stump and so he tries to time it over the infield. Makes good connection but the elevation wasn't there. Mahmudullah at mid off gets to his left and takes an easy catch.
Abu Jayed is brought back into the attack.
Touch full and just outside off, Nabi goes with hard hands but gets an inside edge onto his pads. They scamper for a quick single before the fielder could get to it.
Works the short of a length delivery to the leg side and picks up a single.
Wide! Too short and way over Shenwari's head. The umpire signals wide.
Another bumper and it's pulled away through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short delivery outside off, the batsman fails to get any bat on it.
Goes for the pull off the short delivery and manages to get it just behind the square leg fielder. One run added to the total.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Abu Hider to bowl once more.
Tries to chop the widish delivery but misses.
Mohammad Nabi walks out to the middle.

OUT! Going too hard, too early and pays the price. Gets a short of a length delivery and tries to hit over the mid-wicket boundary for another maximum. But the connection wasn't there and the fielder walks inside the boundary and Sabbir Rahman (sub) takes an easy catch. Afghanistan skipper is gone as they lose another wicket.
SIX! Easy peasy for the Skip! He gets a low full toss outside off and all he has to do is get it from the middle, which he does. The ball was going into the cover stands as soon as he hit it.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.

SIX! Goes fuller and pays the price! Shenwari is waiting for the deliveries in his half and making the most of them. Stays back in his crease and plays through the line, over the bowler's head and gets it over for a biggie.
On a good length outside off, Samiullah fails to make any contact with the ball.
Ariful Haque to bowl for the first time in this innings.
Outside off on a good length, cut to point to end the over.

SIX! Right out of the screws! Such power from Asghar Stanikzai. Full outside off, he knows it's in his slot and so he throws everything behind it. Goes deep inside the crease and smokes it over the long on boundary for a maximum.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short. Wide called by the umpire.
Leans ahead and knocks this fullish ball to long on for a single.

Stifled appeal for a leg before which is shut down. Fuller in length on leg and it keeps tailing down, catches Shenwari on the pads who misses his attempted flick shot. The bowler turns and appeals, only to be disappointed.
Good running this time. Stanikzai taps this down in front of backward point and both batsmen set off. There is a shy at the bowler's end which misses. Nicely done.
Length delivery on off stump, dabbed in front of cover-point for no run. Was too close to the fielder.
Abu Jayed returns to the attack.
Down the leg side, brushes off his pads and into the hands of the keeper, who appeals enthusiastically. The umpire ignores the appeal. No run to end the 11th over.
Shenwari gets a bottom edge while attempting to sweep. The ball rolls towards short third man.
Punched off the back foot to the cover region. Another single for the batsman.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total
Plays the flatter delivery off his pads to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! BANG! Skipper gets into the act now. A loopy delivery outside the off stump, Stanikzai gives the charge, gets under the ball and gets it up and over the long on boundary. The fielder stationed there is a mere spectator as the ball goes over his head for a maximum.
Mehidy Hasan back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side as they pick up a single.
A short of a length delivery from Hider, Shenwari plays it across the line and takes a single from the square leg region.
Opens the face of the bat and guides it behind point for another single.
Touch short and coming into the body, Shenwari plays the pull but doesn't get the proper connection. Still manages to get it down to fine leg for a single.
The batsman just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball from the left-arm pacer.
Goes around the wicket straightaway, gets it into the body of the batsman, who hoicks it with the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Abu Hider to bowl again.
Short again, this time it's outside off, Shenwari throws his bat at it and fails to make any kind of connection. A successful over from Abu Jayed comes to an end.
Samiullah Shenwari to bat next.

OUT! Jayed strikes! This is good bowling. Hits the deck hard and somewhat catches Usman Ghani by surprise, who attempts to play the pull shot. Gets it off the gloves and lobs it behind towards Mushfiqur Rahim, who collects it with glee. Good delivery, both the openers are back in the dugout now.
Short of a good length into the body, Stanikzai with a little swivel pulls it through backward square leg. There's protection out there in the deep so the batsmen can manage just the single.
Full outside off, Stanikzai mistimes the drive and finds the man at mid off.
Landed on a good length on middle and off, Ghani slightly moves inside the line and tucks it in front of square on the leg side for one.
Full delivery veering in on the pads, flicked away behind square leg for an easy single.
Abu Jayed to have a go with the ball.
Sweeps the flighted delivery behind square for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Asghar Stanikzai is the next batsman in.

OUT! Gone! Shahzad goes for a long walk back to the pavilion. Islam flights the ball, pitches it on the off stump and makes the batsman commit a mistake. Shahzad tries to go for another reverse sweep but misses and the ball hits him on his front pad. The bowler and the keeper appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shahzad wasn't happy with the decision and rightly so. The replays suggest that the ball hit him on his glove. No reviews in this series and an unfortunate decision comes to Bangladesh's rescue.
Full and on the pads, the batsman works it to the mid-wicket region and takes a single.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Reverse sweeps it fine behind the keeper. The fielder at short third man gets around and the batsman keeps it under two.
Bit comical but safe. The batsman looks to duck under the short ball but doesn't keep his bat down. The rising ball hits his bat and drops to the on side. No harm done in the end.

FOUR! Cuts and cuts ferociously! Ghani gets read the lengt early, stays in his crease and chops the ball hard through the backward point region. The fielder tries to stop that but it has too much power on it. 50-run stand up for the opening partnership.
Wide! Too short and over the batsman's head. The umpire signals wide.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and wide, Ghani fails to put his bat to it.
Works the ball off his pads and takes a single. Another4 run added from the square leg region.
On a good length, Shahzad chops it to point fielder and scampers for a tight single.
Fired in on the middle stump, the batsman drives it to mid on for nothing.
Gets back into his crease and play the shortish delivery straight to the mid-wicket fielder.

Slight halt in play. Seems there is water stuck or lodged in the grass. The Bangladeshi players aren't happy with that, indicating to the umpires they do something about it. So, the groundstaff is out and doing its work.
Width offered outside off, shorter in length, chopped straight to the man at cover-point.
SIX! Shot. Makes good use of the feet on this occasion. Sees the flight and jumps out of his crease. Gets close to the pitch and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Plays this flatter ball back in the bowler's direction.
Flat and short on the stumps, pulled over mid-wicket. Liton Das out in the deep moves to his left and dives to stop the ball. Good effort, saves two runs for his side.
Drags his length back and doesn't allow the batsman to work it around where he wants. Straight to mid on. Good ball to end the over.
Drives the flighted delivery straight to mid off.
Under edge from Shahzad. He is looking to force his way through but isn't getting it rightly. Tries working it on the leg side but can't middle it.
Comes in with the angle, Ghani flicks it past square leg for a single.
Drives the fullish delivery to cover-point for nothing.
Gets the flatter delivery on off and forces it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, on a length and the batsman tickles it off his pads to square leg for a single.
Good ball, surprises the batsman who does well to duck and leave the bouncer for the keeper.
Gets on the front foot and drives the good length ball to mid off for nothing.
FIVE WIDES! Too straight and down the leg side, the ball misses the bat, pads and goes past the left of the keeper as well. Welcome runs for the batsman.
Gets this one to jag in from a length, Shahzad stays in his crease and gets the ball off the outside half of the bat to the point region for a single.

Leg bye! Touch too straight on the pads, on a good length, Ghani tries to tickle it fine but misses the line and gets hit on the side of the knee. One run added to the total. The medical team comes out in the middle to look after the batsman, who looks to be in some agony.
Goes around the wicket and gets it fuller, just outside the off stump. The batsman goes for the big hoick but misses. The ball goes to the keeper.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. The ball races to the boundary. The Umpire signals a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shakib Al Hasan brings himself into the attack.
Another chop from the batsman, straight to the fielder.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square on the off side. Dot ball.

Stumping appeal which is turned down! Islam provides a lot of flight on this occasion, outside off, Ghani looks to loft it over the off side but is beaten completely by the flight. The keeper collects the ball and whips the bails off. Loud appeal, but Ghani's back leg never came out of the crease.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Drifting in on off, Ghani moves inside the line and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length and outside off, cut away on the off side for nothing.

SIX! BANG! Shahzad is in no mood to let the bowler settle. He gets the similar delivery on leg stump, plants his foot down and gets it up and over the long on boundary for half a dozen. 18 runs off the first over and Afghanistan are off to a flying start.

FOUR! WOW! No half measures from the big man. He gets the delivery he was looking for, on middle and leg and full in length. Shahzad goes through the shot and puts it through the wide long on region for a boundary.
Nazmul Islam will bowl from the other end.
Wide! Hasan is getting defensive. He doesn't want the batsman to get under the ball. Gets too wide on the leg side and the umpire stretches his arms to signal wide.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tries to sweep the flatter delivery from the middle stump but misses as the connection isn't right.
Wide! This time he moves back, trying to flick it from the pads but misses the ball and so does the keeper. The ball rolls behind the wicket and runs three.
FOUR! Shahzad gets going! Similar delivery from Hasan, Shahzad shuffles across his stumps and behind the line of the delivery and picks it over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Starts with a flighted delivery on the pads, Shahzad blocks it on the on side.
We are ready to begin. Mohammad Shahzad and Usman Ghani open the innings for Afghanistan, while Mehidy Hasan takes the ball first up. Here we go...

Shakib Al Hasan says they want to win the match, so the toss doesn't really matter. States he wants his side to finish the series on a high and it hurts to lose the series. Reckons today is another day and a win in this game will give them confidence for their upcoming games. Let's everyone know there are three changes as Abu Jayed, Ariful Haque and Mehidy Hasan come in for Rubel Hossain, Mosaddek Hossain and Sabbir Rahman.

Asghar Stanikzai says they would like to bat first. Mentions they want to play good and positive cricket and is taking the bat first because the ball will turn a lot later on. Informs there is one change as Aftab Alam comes in for Shapoor Zadran.
Toss - Tails is the call from the Bangladesh captain and it's heads. Afghanistan win the toss and they will bat first!

Pitch Report - Ed Rainsford doing the pitch report says there's not going to be much bounce and there isn't much grass, so the spinners will play their part again. Adds that previous games have shown you don't need a big score to win at this venue. Ends by saying that the batsmen will have to play the spinners out as they will be the key.

On the other hand, Bangladesh would feel outplayed in all the aspects of the game. There captain, Shakib Al Hasan hasn't been able to lead the team from the front. They have played some very good cricket but in bits and pieces, which has been their downfall in the series. The last game of the series is a dead rubber, however, both the teams would want to win. Afghanistan surely want to put the final nail in the coffin and enhance their dominance in their second series against a Test playing nation, whereas, the Bangla Tigers will look to salvage some pride and look to hit back in a nothing-to-lose game. All in all, it's going to be another juicy affair and we're looking forward to it.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the third T20I between Afghanistan and Bangladesh from the Rajvi Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Dehradun. Afghanistan have already sealed the series when they beat the visitors by 6 wickets in the last match. The Afghan skipper Asghar Stanikzai has used his bowlers cleverly and hasn't allowed the Bangladesh batsmen to get any easy runs. Rashid Khan and company has been on the money since the first match, along with their formidable batting line-up.
